attributes.residual: real 24, insns 452/452, opcode multiset IDENTICAL (pure reorder). One single cluster at fn+0x2a4-0x2b4. TARGET: `lfs f1,184; lfs f3,192; lfs f0,188; fmuls f2,f1,f1; ...` -- all three operand loads issue before any multiply. OURS: `lfs f0,184; lfs f3,192; fmuls f2,f0,f0; lfs f0,188; ...` -- the first multiply is hoisted above the third load. NAMED MECHANISM: this is a scratch-FPR selection decision, not a scheduling decision. Target loads dx into f1, leaving f0 free for dy, which lets all three loads issue back to back. We load dx into f0, so f0 must be consumed by `fmuls f2,f0,f0` before it can be reused for dy, which forces the multiply up between the loads. Every instruction from fn+0x2b4 onward, including both fadds operand orders, is already exact.
